# Method GetFamilyDriverRelatedToCodeDriver

#### GetFamilyDriverRelatedToCodeDriver(ElementId, string, out string)

This Method fetchs the name of family driver related to a code driver.

##### Declaration

```
[OperationContract]
[AvailableSinceVersion(7, 21, 155, 0)]
void GetFamilyDriverRelatedToCodeDriver(ElementId inElementId, string inCodeDriverName, out string outFamilyDriverName)
```

##### Parameters

|  Type |  Name |  Description |  
| --- | --- | --- | 
   
|  ElementId |  inElementId |  Inclusion  |  
 
|  string |  inCodeDriverName |  driver name to look for  |  
 
|  string |  outFamilyDriverName |  name of related family driver  |
